v22-5.candidate: For the crushings of death surrounded me; torrents of lawlessness stunned me.
v22-5.display:
For the crushings of death surrounded me;
torrents of lawlessness stunned me.

v22-17.candidate: He sent from on high and took me; He drew me out of many waters.
v22-17.display:
He sent from on high and took me;
He drew me out of many waters.

v22-29.candidate: For Thou art my lamp, Lord; the Lord will light my darkness for me.
v22-29.display:
For Thou art my lamp, Lord;
the Lord will light my darkness for me.

v22-30.candidate: For by Thee I will run lightly armed; by my God I will pass over a wall.
v22-30.display:
For by Thee I will run lightly armed;
by my God I will pass over a wall.
